mapper.select: select id, studentID, name, password, phoneNumber from student
select id, studentID, name, password, phoneNumber from student where id = #{id}
select id, studentID, name, password, phoneNumber from student where studentID = #{studentID}
select id, studentID, name, password, phoneNumber from student where name = #{name}
select id, studentID, name, password, phoneNumber from student where phoneNumber = #{phoneNumber}
mapper.insert: insert into student(studentID, name, password, phoneNumber) VALUES (#{studentID}, #{name}, #{password}, #{phoneNumber})
mapper.update: update student set password = #{password}, phoneNumber = #{phoneNumber} where id = #{id};
